name: ARBOR Technology Corp.
summary: Established in 1993 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, ARBOR Technology Corp. specializes in delivering industrial Internet of Things (IoT) computing and mobile solutions to a global market. Their extensive product line includes RISC computing offerings such as embedded boards, box systems, and panel computers. The company also provides a comprehensive suite of embedded computing products, which encompasses computer-on-modules, PC/104, PC/104+, single-board computers, slot computing devices, industrial and semi-industrial motherboards, alongside chassis, backplanes, power supplies, and various accessories. Furthermore, ARBOR manufactures rugged mobile computing solutions, featuring handheld devices, tablets, and specialized panels. In the medical sector, they offer computing products like medical stations, patient infotainment and monitoring terminals, healthcare IoT devices, and mobile clinical assistants. For industrial automation, their portfolio spans IoT devices, intelligent power systems, digital signage players, panel PCs, factory automation equipment, and transportation solutions. These advanced offerings serve a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, logistics, transportation, industrial automation, industrial safety, and retail.
